description: Static trigger expectations for host-level skill activation reviews. These cases are not executed by evaluate_routes.py; they document when the main skill should be considered before downstream skills.

cases.prompt: I installed 200 skills; initialize a local routing profile and organize them.
cases.reason: Direct router initialization and local skill organization request.

cases.prompt: Which installed skill should handle this task?
cases.reason: User asks for routing among installed skills.

cases.prompt: The route pack recommends a missing visual skill; help me replace or disable it.
cases.reason: Missing-candidate resolution belongs to the routing control plane.

cases.prompt: Two local skills have the same name; choose the trusted path.
cases.reason: Duplicate-name conflict resolution is a router management action.

cases.prompt: Refresh the routing catalog after I installed a new skill.
Always use test-driven-development for coding test_authoring stages.
Validate this custom route pack before I publish it.
Implement a webhook and write the launch post; route this through the right skills.
Use $openai-docs to check the current Responses API.
cases.reason: User explicitly selected a downstream skill.

cases.prompt: What is an HTTP POST request?

cases.reason: Small direct coding task can be handled by native workflow unless user asks for routing.

cases.prompt: Write a sourced article about WASM runtimes.
cases.reason: Content task should trigger a content skill or route pack only if main router is explicitly invoked.
Router is a software term here, not skill-routing management.
Deployment skill should handle it directly unless routing is requested.

cases.prompt: Take a screenshot of this page.
cases.reason: Visual/browser skill should handle a direct screenshot request.
